assets.hair: long straight dark hair tucked behind both ears
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: high-resolution full-body fashion model cutout PNG for a real web wardrobe and virtual try-on application.
Primary request: Create ONE entirely new, fictional adult Chinese woman, age 28, wearing an oatmeal long-sleeve henley knit sweater with three small turquoise buttons, medium blue straight-leg jeans, and ivory low-profile leather sneakers.
Subject: healthy average build with natural shoulders, waist and hips; long straight dark hair tucked behind both ears; understated natural makeup, gentle calm expression looking directly toward the camera.
Composition/framing: Portrait aspect ratio 2:3. A straight-on full-body catalog photograph, neutral standing pose, head vertical and front facing, shoulders square to camera, both arms relaxed slightly away from torso, both hands fully visible with natural fingers, no hands in pockets, feet slightly apart. Include the entire crown of the hair and the entire shoes with 5–7% breathing room above and below. One single woman centered and fully within the image. Occupy most of the portrait height without cropping.
Style: extremely crisp modern professional studio e-commerce photography, high-resolution fine detail, natural skin pores and individual hair strands, clear eyes and facial features, clean sharp garment boundaries, realistic stitching, detailed knit or fabric weave, true realistic body anatomy, clean cutout edges.
Lighting: warm-neutral soft studio lighting with gentle form shadows ON the person and garments, even exposure, no beauty blur, no depth-of-field blur. Use portrait lens perspective without distortion.
Background: genuinely TRANSPARENT alpha channel, nothing behind the subject, no opaque background, no floor or ground plane, no cast floor shadow, no fake checkerboard pattern.
Constraints: all clothing fully opaque and correctly worn; no bag, no props, no jewelry except tiny simple stud earrings if any; no labels, text, branding, watermark, borders, graphics, other people, or collage; no illustration or 3D-render appearance; no motion blur, over-smoothing, excessive sharpening halos, overexposure, impossible anatomy, extra fingers, cropped feet, crossed limbs or dramatic pose.
